critique.evidence: The high-contrast headline states the thesis immediately—“The signature is valid. The intent was stolen.”—and the supporting sentence explains that payment authorization and human intent are evaluated separately. “FOLLOW THE PAYMENT” is a prominent, action-oriented primary CTA at every viewport, while the numbered intent/agent/page/payment cards provide a concrete case trail. Clarity is slightly reduced by specialist phrases such as “release-custodied synthetic signatures” and by the mobile flow, where the connectors and “AUTHENTIC ≠ INTENDED” conclusion are separated from the relevant cards by substantial space.
critique.fix: Replace the specialist opening phrase with plain language and keep the mobile evidence cards, connectors, and “AUTHENTIC ≠ INTENDED” verdict in one tighter sequential flow so the cause of the intent mismatch is explicit without interpretation.
